comments: Vendor: UNITED GLOBAL VENTURES PRIVATE LIMITED, trading as Lazynext (Bengaluru, India; https://lazynext.com). Free tier: 3 rendered scans/day per IP, no account required. Pro is a $9/month subscription (unlimited scans, site crawls, monitors). The same scanner is also published as a REST API, MCP server, A2A agent card and GitHub Action: https://github.com/Lazynext-AI/accessibility-checker. No public accessibility statement URL yet; one is planned.
features: Scans a page or a whole site for WCAG 2.1/2.2 issues in a real browser. 75 automated checks cover ARIA, keyboard focus order, focus visibility, contrast and target size, with an accessibility score, shareable report and daily monitoring. Free: 3 scans a day, no signup. Pro adds unlimited scans, site crawls and API access.
provider: UNITED GLOBAL VENTURES PRIVATE LIMITED (trading as Lazynext)
